name: Missions
overview: Scripture emphasizes the call to proclaim God's salvation and declare His glory among all nations and peoples, as seen in the exhortations to sing unto the LORD from all the earth and among the heathen (1 Chronicles 16:23-24; Psalms 96:1; Psalms 18:49). The example of priests being sent to teach foreign peoples the fear of the LORD (2 Kings 17:27-28) illustrates the early mission efforts to bring knowledge of God beyond Israel. This demonstrates that missions involve both worship and instruction, extending God's marvelous works and salvation to the nations.
